counterargs.read: Today reads as a clean continuation of yesterday's relief — vol collapsing, credit firm, Korea and semis both rallying hard. But the move sits on top of a still-restrictive long end and a plumbing picture that's a week stale until tonight's H.4.1 print. The RRP reversal back toward zero is the one data point arguing for caution: it says the liquidity cushion, not just sentiment, is still thin. Today's balance sheet release and tomorrow's retail sales will confirm or break this relief rally.
